about_the_game:
Fight the World. Face Yourself.

CULY is a pixel-art RPG about a robot searching for purpose in a broken world of forgotten machines. Along this journey, you will meet allies, enemies, and haunting memories, and decide whether your mistakes define you or if you can become something more.

Dual Battle System

Battle against your enemies in a turn-based combat: Attack, block, heal, and evolve your skills as you grow. Build your Psyche to unleash devastating breakdowns, and master the Catch Bar, a rhythm-based timing mechanic that grants energy and shields.

But not every fight is against another robot. Some battles are within: bullet-hell survival encounters where doubt, regret, and guilt become your enemies.

Besides combat, explore The Wasteland, meet allies, and uncover haunting memory fragments that reveal the truth about your past. Dialogue choices shape your relationships and encounters, even as the story drives toward a single powerful conclusion.

Features

  • Turn-based combat with evolving skills and strategy.

  • Psyche & Catch Bar systems that reward timing and risk.

  • Emotional battles that shift into a bullet-hell survival experience.

  • Exploration & dialogue in a mysterious, broken world.

  • Memory fragments that piece together CULY’s past.

  • Atmospheric pixel art & original soundtrack.

CULY is a game about imperfection, loss, and hope. Reminds us that even in a broken world, trying to be better makes all the difference.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes story elements that explore darker themes and emotional moments. Some scenes feature unsettling or subtly horror-inspired imagery, presented in a stylized and non-graphic manner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX 10 support (512 MB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: A story-rich RPG where fighting the world is only half the battle. The rest is inside.
